description_en: Creates a data source for data forwarding
description_zh: 调用该接口创建待流转的数据源
name: CreateParserDataSource

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or the ID is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The data source name. The name can contain Chinese characters, letters, Japanese characters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name must be 1 to 30 characters in length. A Chinese character or Japanese character counts as two characters
parameters.help_zh: 数据源名称，支持中文、英文字母、日文、数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-），长度为1~30个字符，一个中文及日文占2个字符
parameters.name: name
